facts.fact: Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying e-GA has enabled public institutions to deliver online services through ICT systems such as the main government portal, the Ajira portal and e-Parliament, and that mGov is used by 429 institutions.
facts.system: Government main portal, Ajira portal, e-Parliament, mGov

facts.fact: Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying local e-GA experts build, manage and run the e-Government systems used in public institutions.

Nipashe reports that the e-Government Authority built the Government Mailing System used by 770 institutions, the mGov system used by 429 and the GeOS office system used by 347, and runs GovNet connecting 457 public offices.

Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying e-GA built the GMS, used by 770 institutions, and that such systems are built and run by local experts, saving money once spent buying systems from foreign contractors.

Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying e-GA built the mGov mobile government services system, used by 429 institutions, and that such systems are built and run by local experts, saving money once spent buying systems from foreign contractors.

Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying e-GA built the GeOS office system, used by 347 institutions, and that such systems are built and run by local experts, saving money once spent buying systems from foreign contractors.

Nipashe quotes the e-GA director general as saying e-GA designed and built the GovESB government data exchange system, and that such systems are built and run by local experts, saving money once spent buying systems from foreign contractors.

TZA.note: GovNet connects 457 public offices but none is named as a local government office.
